title: Planck plus BICEP-Keck 2015 limits the tensor-to-scalar ratio below 0.06
summary: With BICEP-Keck 2015 B-mode data, the paper states a 95 percent upper limit r0.002 < 0.06.
body: The conclusions of Planck 2018 results VI say that combining with BICEP-Keck 2015 data on B-mode polarization gives a 95 percent upper limit on the tensor-to-scalar ratio r0.002 < 0.06. The limit is that combination, at that confidence level, for the ratio named r at the scale written 0.002. It is not a detection of primordial gravitational waves. The same paragraph says these results favour concave over convex inflation potentials. That preference is the authors' reading of the limit together with their measurement of the scalar spectral index. This card states the limit.
